name: ctx-limit
description: Set a context-size limit for a Claude Code session. A UserPromptSubmit hook checks context size each turn and, past the threshold, blocks the prompt, warns, or runs a command — your choice. Control/handoff commands (/ctx-limit, /junkd:handoff, /junkd:handon, /junkd:ahandoff, /clear) always pass. Live, no new session.
